name: writing-skills
description: Agent skills that help writers plan, write, edit and review documentation, blogs, newsletters and social posts. Three plugins: tw for technical writing, cw for content writing, and write for the rules both use.

plugins.name: write
plugins.description: The rules under any piece of writing: plain language, claims backed by sources, code samples that run, and a check for machine-written prose. Comes with tw and cw.

plugins.name: tw
plugins.description: Technical writing skills: plan a docs set, write developer docs, help-centre articles, internal docs, API references, READMEs and release notes, research the code, interview engineers, and review, audit and edit docs. Includes write.

plugins.name: cw
plugins.description: Content writing skills for any blog or newsletter on any subject: plan topics, research sources, write posts, newsletter issues and social posts, pitch and collaborate, edit and review, cross-post, refresh old pieces and read the analytics. Includes write.
